exposure: maternal clinical predictors at IOL admission
outcome: cesarean section indications (abnormal fetal heart rate, labor dystocia)
cohort: The study included 2434 singleton term pregnant women referred for induction of labor to a tertiary Obstetrics center between January 2018 and December 2021.
finding: A prognostic model for predicting vaginal delivery after labor induction achieved good discrimination with an AUROC of 0.794, identifying key influencing features such as Bishop score and previous deliveries.
mod_finding: The prognostic model effectively predicted vaginal delivery after induction of labor, achieving an AUROC of 0.794, which can aid in personalized counseling regarding the risk of cesarean section.
